disposition_reason: Section 6.8.2 requires producers to control heavy metals and points to informative Appendix A; Table A.1 gives arsenic and lead 'límites máximos' (mg/kg) for cacao, chocolate and similar products, cocoa (powder), cocoa paste/cake, cocoa butter, and cocoa-sugar mixes/chocolate powder. No cadmium value.
disposition_locator: 6.8.2; 15. Apéndice A Informativo Tabla A.1, PDF p. 11; definitions 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 3.16, 3.20, 3.24, 3.30

study.material_scope: cacao beans, chocolate and similar products, cocoa powder, cocoa paste/cake, cocoa butter, cocoa-sugar mixes
